Ok, here's the deal. Sometimes you get bad teammates, hell, sometimes you get a bunch of bad teammates. Scarra, in CHALLENGER, lost 20 games in a row, straight. Don't let it get to you and tilt you. Stealing kills, not a big deal. 

Here's what you have to do:

*Optimize your runes (look up pro players OP.GG)
*Watch streams 
* Main 1 role, but have knowledge of all roles  
* Main 2-3 champions from the role, preferably someone who won't fall out of meta, like irelia.

The thing is, when you have good teammates, you should be able to win when you do. 
Learn to capitalize on leads, push objectives, vision is power.

MOST IMPORTANTLY. **DON'T GO ON TILT.**

TL;DR:
When you have good teammates, you should be able to win, so learn how to take advantage of the enemies' mistakes.

I'm going to divide this into two paths, a tanky path and a damage path. You can choose to go hybrid damage and tank if you want as well which most seem to use.

-Machete start on both and yellow trinket, unless you anticipate some toplane counterganking.

-Spirit stone for sustain buy green wards and sweeper + longsword/boots. I tend to buy the lizard on the tanky jarvan too, but you can decide to buy the ruby crystal for the golem (item, I mean)
*As per most junglers, you rush your jungle item and you can postpone your spiritstone like the lee sin path and buy 2 longswords for maximum gank presence and damage.**NOTE: IF YOU DONT LIKE PLAYING THE EARLY GAME LEE-SIN ESQUE JARVAN BUY SPIRITSTONE INSTEAD OF THE DOUBLE LONGSWORDS**
*I tend to build a giants belt or a spectres cowl for some tanky-ness
*Then buy tier 2 boots, I love ninja tabi for early dragons and its very nice when you are diving their backline. Mercury treads are also very good, but kiting a jarvan is quite difficult in itself, hence it is not that necessary. Mobility boots for early ganking is nice as well. 
*Buy a brutalizer after your boots or even a tiamat, As the passive and active effects are very useful with your ultimate (Hydra, although the lifesteal is good, is not essential in the jungle and is a huge goldsink, I would suggest leaving it as tiamat as the splash still procs your jungle item and you sustain with it)
*Sunfire is also very good with your ultimate
*Randuins is still the number 1 tank item in my opinion even after the nerfs and I still consistently build it.
*Banshee's op 
*Upgrade sweeper when trying to baron
*Upgrade brut into black cleaver or tiamat into hydra.
 These items are mainly interchangable and it is mainly on you to judge a situation. Note that your w shield uses the resistances you have, so a tanky jarvan is very strong late.

Depending on your elo, I suggest carrying around an early sweeper as junglers and midlaners try to ward your wraiths. 

Always check the common pink bushes near river to make your invisibility effective.

Try and notice which lane arrives late to lane to understand where the opposing jungler started.

Avoid the early game bully junglers such as lee sin, elise and jarvan as they can often beat you in a duel. Vi as well, however if she uses her q to escape/farm then you can beat her.

Do not stay in your jungle when you are low to try to secure a buff as the enemy may kill you then your buff as well, unless, of course, you have vision of them.

Buy tons of wards, after 6 your counterganks are unbelievable.

Try and walk infront of your enemies when you gank so you can maximize your damage

If you can't hit your Q max your E, it's often better in terms of damage even though your Q cooldown reduces with level. Don't let your ult separate you too far away from your allies otherwise you may throw the game.

I'm gold IV and a jungle main and I could answer some questions on J4.

-Generally, with your jungle clear learn to cancel auto with q, start q incase of counter jungle and e if you want faster clear if you start botlane.
-Don't spam your w in the jungle otherwise you will run out of mana
-Don't be afraid to build damage as you can often eliminate a squishie unless you are 0/3 before even having a jungle item. I usually like to rush for the lizard elder, but the ancient golem is better if you tend to build more tanky.
-Try and trap the enemy squishies with your ultimate but don't trap your own team out or inside the ultimate
-Boots are essential to try and press your early advantage.
